answer: Each agent pins an identity to an anchor record, locking 70 credits, claims under a ferrous seal. A grove of auditors replays claims each epoch: one identity's two conflicting claims prove fraud, slashing it, half to the catcher. First fake: 45 plus the bond; k-th: 45+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 2,542,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented anchor fails: a second key on one anchor burns both. Honest agents pay 45 once and reclaim it.
